query:
UPDATE job_enqueue_intents
         SET status = 'PROMOTED',
             promotion_attempts = promotion_attempts + 1,
             last_attempted_at = now(),
             promoted_job_id = $2,
             promoted_at = now(),
             conflicted_at = NULL,
             last_error_code = NULL,
             last_error_message = NULL
         WHERE id = $1
           AND status = 'PENDING'
